Regulation and technology

Since its emergence, the internet has been a disruptive technology that radically changed the way we communicate. It produced significant changes in our communications ecosystem and decisively affected how we inform ourselves, how we argue, and how we shape the public conversation that underpins every constitutional democracy. That disruption produced unexpected effects and various anxieties, which —in many cases— were addressed through attempts to shape the internet by means of regulatory initiatives of different kinds.
